=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:318-334 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new PID namespace wraps only the harness's own process tree, while the rootless Docker daemon that start_rootless_dockerd launches stays in the runner's host PID namespace: daemon_env has no `DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_FLAGS=--pidns` and the daemon has no `unshare --pid` wrapper. The harness still reaches that daemon through DOCKER_HOST (build_sandbox_env line 189; harness launch lines 919-920).
  WHY: A generated test inside the namespace can run `docker run --rm --pid=host <image> ps -ef`, or bind-mount `/proc`, and list every runner process with its cmdline. Neither SELFCHECK_PROBE (lines 605-631) nor SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE (lines 634-651) checks the Docker path, so selfcheck reports ok. All reviewers rated this MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:109-119 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: validate_config accepts any absolute path for VALIDATION_HARNESS_SANDBOX_PIDNS_STATE_DIR that matches `^/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$` and lies outside the sandbox home, including `/run`, `/tmp`, `/home` and `/var`. ensure_pidns_state_dir (line 232) then runs `install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root` on that path.
  WHY: Reviewers say a misconfigured value would make provision, selfcheck or run chown an existing system directory such as `/run` to root and set it to mode 0700, breaking runner services, and that test_an_invalid_state_dir_is_refused does not cover these inputs. Severity disagreement: gemini BLOCKER; luna, qwen and glm MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 treated this only as a hardening item. minimax also disputes that GNU `install -d` changes the mode or owner of an existing directory.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Run the entire harness in a credential-free, separate user and PID namespace with isolated Docker access; fail closed if isolation is unavailable." (linked issue #7349, Recommendation)
  expected_change_site: scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh — start_rootless_dockerd (lines 318-334) / sandbox_start_verified_dockerd (lines 425-467): rootlesskit `--pidns` via DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_FLAGS in daemon_env, or an unshare wrapper. Plus SELFCHECK_PROBE / SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE (lines 605-651): a probe that runs a `--pid=host` container and fails closed if it sees host PIDs.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches start_rootless_dockerd (lines 318-334), sandbox_start_verified_dockerd or the provision daemon start. daemon_env still holds only PATH/HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/[DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS], with no rootlesskit `--pidns` flag and no `unshare --pid` wrapper for the daemon. SELFCHECK_PROBE and SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE never use Docker. The diff changes only validate_config, the pidns helpers, cmd_provision, cmd_selfcheck, cmd_cleanup and cmd_run, so it isolates the harness process but not the daemon.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:start_rootless_dockerd, lines 321-328; cmd_run, lines 919-920; build_sandbox_env, line 189 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The PID namespace only wraps the harness's process tree. The rootless dockerd and its rootlesskit child stay in the runner's host PID namespace (start_rootless_dockerd is unchanged and no `--pidns` flag is set in DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_FLAGS), and DOCKER_HOST still reaches that daemon.
  WHY: A test can run `docker run --rm --pid=host <image> ps -ef` or bind-mount `/proc` and list runner processes with their cmdlines. Neither SELFCHECK_PROBE nor SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE (lines 634-651) checks the Docker path, so selfcheck and checked-run report ok.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Run the entire harness in a credential-free, separate user and PID namespace with isolated Docker access; fail closed if isolation is unavailable." (linked issue #7349, Recommendation)
  Expected change site: scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh, start_rootless_dockerd / sandbox_start_verified_dockerd (for example `DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_FLAGS=--pidns` in daemon_env), plus a selfcheck step that fails closed when a container can see host PIDs.
  Evidence of absence: No hunk in start_rootless_dockerd (lines 318-334) or sandbox_start_verified_dockerd, no `--pidns` flag or unshare wrapper for the daemon, and no Docker-path probe in SELFCHECK_PROBE or SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING (2 related items): (1) validate_config, lines 109-119, and ensure_pidns_state_dir, line 232: the state-dir check accepts `//`, `/run`, `/tmp` and `/home`, and install -d may chmod or chown an existing system directory to root 0700. Suggested fix: require two or more path components, refuse shared roots, and refuse an existing directory unless `stat` reports `0 700`. About 6 lines. Downgraded from a finding because only an operator can set the value. (2) start_rootless_dockerd, line 321: append `DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_FLAGS=--pidns` and add a `--pid=host` selfcheck that fails with the token `docker_host_pid_visible`. About 6-10 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:109-118 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: validate_config does not validate VALIDATION_HARNESS_SANDBOX_PIDNS_STATE_DIR enough, and ensure_pidns_state_dir runs install as root on that directory, which can break system directories.
  WHY: Runner services break if the variable is set to a critical system path such as /run or /etc.

  PROBLEM: The Docker daemon is started in the host PID namespace and is not isolated, so `docker run --pid=host` bypasses the PID namespace isolation.
  WHY: Validation tests can escape the PID namespace isolation the task intends.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:start_rootless_dockerd at lines 318-334; cmd_run DOCKER_HOST at line 869, as_sandbox_in_pidns at lines 248-255, 919 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rootless dockerd stays in the host PID namespace: there is no `unshare --pid`, no rootlesskit `--pidns`, and no DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_FLAGS=--pidns in daemon_env. The PID-namespaced harness still uses `DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/<uid>/docker.sock`. SELFCHECK_PROBE (lines 605-631) and SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE (lines 634-651) never invoke Docker.
  WHY: A test can run `docker run --rm --pid=host busybox cat /proc/<controller_pid>/environ` and see runner processes' cmdline, and their environ where file modes allow it. The changelog claim that tests "can no longer see the runner's processes" is therefore false once a test calls docker.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Run the entire harness in a credential-free, separate user and PID namespace with isolated Docker access; fail closed if isolation is unavailable." (linked issue #7349, Recommendation)
  Expected change site: scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh — start_rootless_dockerd (lines 318-334), sandbox_start_verified_dockerd (lines 425-467), SELFCHECK_PROBE or SELFCHECK_PIDNS_PROBE (lines 605-651). Needs rootlesskit `--pidns`, or a `unshare --pid --fork --mount-proc --kill-child -- dockerd-rootless.sh ...` wrapper, plus a `--pid=host` selfcheck probe.
  Evidence of absence: No hunk touches start_rootless_dockerd or sandbox_start_verified_dockerd. daemon_env still holds only PATH/HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/[DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS]. There is no `--pidns` flag and no unshare wrapper, and the selfcheck probes never touch Docker.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: validate_config (lines 109-119) and ensure_pidns_state_dir (line 232) accept `/run`, `/tmp`, `/var` and `/etc/foo`. `install -d` creates a missing path as root-owned 0700, and the harness writes root-owned `<run>-<attempt>.pid` / `.started` files there. Suggested fix: refuse a first-segment denylist, or require an extra segment and a root-owned 0700 parent. About 4-6 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- NOTE (non-finding): minimax disputes the gpt-6-luna claim. It says GNU `install -d` does not change the mode or ownership of an existing directory. It also says test_an_invalid_state_dir_is_refused does not pin `/run`, `/tmp`, `/var` or `/etc/foo`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:validate_config, lines 109-118; ensure_pidns_state_dir, line 232 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Path validation (regex `^/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$`) accepts top-level system directories such as `/run` or `/tmp`, and `install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root` then changes the permissions of existing system directories.

- HARDENING: validate_config, lines 109-118: require two path components with the regex `^/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$`. About 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5
